description: How to add another INITE MCP server to this client, when the person wants something this one does not do. With no argument, the server beside this one; `for`, the one that does a job; `all: true`, every server. Returns the URL, the Claude Code command and the custom-connector step.

all.description: true: every server, with install links. Ignored with `for`.

for.description: What the person wants next; returns the server that does it

name: inite_connect
title: Connect another INITE server
